provenance.invariant: Scheduling identities: ORGANIZER is the eXo organizer (not the pushing account) and carries SCHEDULE-AGENT=CLIENT because the pusher (identity 5) is not the organizer (identity 9); every ATTENDEE carries SCHEDULE-AGENT=CLIENT and a PARTSTAT mapped from the agenda response; a CN holding a comma is quoted; an attendee without a visible email is omitted entirely.
